description: Versioned ingest status contract shared by the Python ingest packages and the JavaScript status scanner. Bump the version on any breaking change; conformance fixtures in the same directory keep both runtimes in agreement.

revisions.description: A source revision identifies the exact sanitized content of a source. It is a lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of 64 characters.

intervals.description: Synchronization intervals are whole seconds greater than zero. Duration strings may carry one of the listed unit suffixes; a bare number is seconds. Fractional values are rejected so an interval can never truncate to zero.

paperless.directoryDescription: Documents are grouped into inclusive ID ranges of idsPerDirectory entries: [start, start + idsPerDirectory - 1], with start a multiple of idsPerDirectory and both bounds zero-padded to at least four digits (padding is a minimum width, so IDs beyond four digits produce wider, equal-width bounds).

revoked.title: # Widerrufene Paperless-Dokumente
revoked.description: The revocation list starts with the title line, followed by one list entry per revoked document ID; blank lines are ignored and IDs are stored as a sorted set.

fieldRules.paperless_url: HTTPS URL of the Paperless document

fieldRules.paperless_id: positive integer matching the source page

frontmatterFields.description: Frontmatter is a --- delimited YAML-like block of name: value lines. A field name may appear at most once. Values are plain text, single-quoted text, or a JSON-encoded value (the value begins with a double quote and is parsed as JSON).

statusResult.description: The wiki_ingest_status tool returns one object per source directory with exactly the statusValues keys, each holding an array. The comparison is driven entirely by the provider manifest (see contracts/provider-manifest/): manifest items without a claiming wiki page are new, pages with a stale revision are outdated, pages with the current revision are current. Pending entries (new, outdated, current) carry source_key, source_path, source_revision, wiki_path, and frontmatter; frontmatter.source_revision must equal source_revision. A wiki_path may be claimed by at most one pending entry across all sources.
